name: San Diego Learning Update - Consistency Weighting
notes: Post-San Diego chaos event. Learned: consistency beats dominance on established tracks.

from_v3_0: Added consistency_weight: 0.04 (reward steady performers on known tracks)
Added local_knowledge_weight: 0.03 (bonus for native region drivers)
Added recent_dnf_penalty: 0.15 (15% performance hit after crashes)
Added established_track_bonus: 0.04 (higher confidence on known tracks)
Added new_track_penalty: -0.05 (lower confidence on brand new tracks)
Added street_course_dominance_penalty: -0.03 (dominance doesn't help unpredictable courses)

san_diego_week_17.description: Corey Heim (part-timer, 13th career start) wins first Cup race. All three predictors wrong. SVG (6 of 8 road wins, defending champ) wrecked Stage 1, DNF 38th.
san_diego_week_17.lesson: Unpredictability > specialist credentials on NEW tracks. Dominance ≠ Destiny.
san_diego_week_17.algorithmic_response: Weight consistency and recent performance. Penalize recent DNFs. Distinguish established vs new tracks.
